title: docs(theme): Include default css theme to the examples
body:
Fixes #507

Same as for the js file, it uses the development version when in dev, or the one form jsdelivr in prod.

I've removed the hierarchical indentation that is now part of default. I've moved specific example styling of the search box to the `default-theme.css`, along with other styling.

We might need to rename that file in the future, and move default styling away from this file.
